headline.text: L1 almond sorting effort stopped after *3 hours* — foreign material found in two lots, no resolution path yet

per_plant_summary.L1: S2 down most of the night sorting almonds for foreign material — stopped at 05:19 with no clear path forward. S3 found metal contamination in two separate incidents, maintenance investigating. Materials shortages (MMK jars, labels, ALDI pouches) limiting schedule flexibility.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML2 temper unit faulted twice but cleared both times — back depositing by 00:35. ML3 cleared a mold jam but guide rails are bent and need replacement parts. FFS finished job and completed level 2 clean.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 and ML4 both mid-changeover — ML1 buffer flush and Hershey almond setup on track, ML4 level 3 clean going well. Truffle line worked through 62 bins of rework from belt alignment issues, down to 8 bins by end of 2nd shift. MF Matrix sensors caused two overflows on 2nd shift.

resolved.title: S4 THG angle conveyor auto-track fault
resolved.summary: First THG belt section pausing with no HMI alarm, auto-track sensor not engaging.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:41 after CILT and retracting belt into auto-track — sensor back on (Erandy Garcilazo Ceja).

resolved.title: S4 black spots on caramel
resolved.summary: Black contamination visible on caramel surface at end of tunnel 2, 3 EEs sorting.
resolved.resolution: Decision at 20:44 to run out caramel and caustic clean kettles starting at 21:00 (Dakota Adair, Curt Willis).

resolved.title: S3 expired ingredient blocked bed loading
resolved.summary: Item 10203 staged at line was expired, preventing bed from loading at 07:06.
resolved.resolution: Bed loading started at 08:24 after locating in-date material (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: ML2 temper unit pressure fault (first occurrence)
resolved.summary: Scraper faulted at 12:36, pressure climbed from 5.3 to 6.7 bar.
resolved.resolution: Reheat to 35C completed, scraper working and tempering again at 12:43 (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML2 temper unit pressure fault (second occurrence)
resolved.summary: Scraper faulted at 23:08, bar at 5.8, third shift starting reheat.
resolved.resolution: DQ1 fuse replaced for heat exchanger at 23:55, two good tempers, depositing at 00:35 (Gustavo Rodas).

resolved.title: ML3 mold jam at cooler bottom
resolved.summary: 6 molds jammed at very bottom of mold return conveyor, tight space with bent guide rails.
resolved.resolution: All molds cleared at 21:04, line back up and running (Brandon Lance, Raymond Fleming).

resolved.title: ML2 bars kicking sideways at flow wrap
resolved.summary: Machine kicking bars sideways every couple of bars, jamming belt near packaging.
resolved.resolution: Line running at 02:03, maintenance shimmed the blade (ML2 FW).

resolved.title: Truffle line M4 belt alignment causing sensor rejects
resolved.summary: Drive roller slipping, chicane misaligning product, 2 EEs manually aligning, 62 bins accumulated.
resolved.resolution: Worked down to 8 bins remaining at 21:36 (Shane Olsen). Drive roller to be addressed at next cleaning downtime.

resolved.title: ML1 sensor missing after changeover
resolved.summary: Sensor missing from equipment during shift exchange, location unknown.
resolved.resolution: Sensor handed over at shift exchange, reinstalled at 04:46 (Kavin Ayala, Imperial).

resolved.title: Forklift #5 fork pins out, LOTO applied
resolved.summary: Fork pins came out, retaining pieces and bolts missing, other two forklifts inspected and tightened.
resolved.resolution: Pin reinstalled with new bolts, tightened, LOTO removed at 05:39 (Kavin Ayala).

resolved.title: LOTO lock left on ML1 imperial air valve
resolved.summary: Lock preventing air to imperial, blocking hopper trial, unknown owner.
resolved.resolution: Form filled, lock cut with bolt cutters at 09:41 (Itzel Chavez, Chad Stone).

resolved.title: ML1 metal detector belt failed ATP
resolved.summary: Belt marked complete but failed visual inspection during level 3 clean.
resolved.resolution: ATP passed at 03:14 after re-cleaning (Gina Vazquez).

needs_attention.title: S2 almond lots J and P foreign material hold
needs_attention.summary: FM found in two almond lots during startup, manual sorting very slow (3 hours for <1/4 tote each), stopped at 05:19 pending new direction from Curt Willis and Alan Todd.
needs_attention.status: Sorting stopped at 05:19, findings bagged and saved. Almond sorting plan with optical sorter in development for Monday (Chad Stone 10:25).

needs_attention.title: Materials shortage limiting schedule flexibility
needs_attention.summary: MMK jars only 3 days supply, labels 2 days, ALDI pouches and TAT materials incomplete — no flexibility to adjust schedule.
needs_attention.status: Pretium producing MMK jars now, ~146K/week available. ALDI tight turnaround, cannot bring forward (Kirk Nickel 10:20). Almond plan as backup.

needs_attention.title: S3 metal contamination in finished product
needs_attention.summary: Bolt found inside bag from MM5 at 10:47, second piece of metal found in cluster at 11:04, both rejected by x-ray and metal detector.
needs_attention.status: Line paused at 10:47 to locate source, maintenance investigating as of 11:04 (Mariela Gudino, Katya Farnsworth).

needs_attention.title: S3 MM3 and MM5 pausing after every dump
needs_attention.summary: Matrix machines 3 and 5 pausing after each dump, impacting throughput, Jason working with Troy.
needs_attention.status: Still troubleshooting as of 10:19, Troy engaged (Katya Farnsworth, Jason, Justin Garner).

needs_attention.title: ML2 temper unit recurring pressure faults on dark sea salt
needs_attention.summary: Two faults in 11 hours on new FEA dark chocolate with salt added at melter, suspected salt accumulation at scraper bottom.
needs_attention.status: Summary posted at 06:28, Jakob requested to review DCSS today if available (Chad Stone 07:12, Alan Todd, Gustavo Rodas).

needs_attention.title: ML3 mold return guide rails bent, need replacement
needs_attention.summary: Both guide rails at cooler bottom very bent after clearing jam, should order replacement parts.
needs_attention.status: Jam cleared but rails still pretty bad, running. Replacement parts needed (Raymond Fleming 21:03).

needs_attention.title: Truffle line M4 drive roller slipping, needs repair
needs_attention.summary: Drive roller slip causing chicane issues and product misalignment, 2 EEs manually aligning to reduce rejects.
needs_attention.status: Rework bins cleared to 8 by 21:36, but root cause (drive roller) will be addressed at next cleaning downtime (Grey Boscan, Jason).

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix sensor overflows on all quadrants
needs_attention.summary: Sensors caused product overflow across all quadrants twice during 2nd shift (17:31 and 19:23).
needs_attention.status: Sensor head angles not adjusted, Bojana continuously monitoring and will adjust if it happens again (Bojana McLeod 20:39, Shawn Jewkes).

needs_attention.title: ML4 drum pump broke during changeover
needs_attention.summary: Pump leaking oil, fell apart when operators removed it, needed for ML1 flush.
needs_attention.status: Borrowed pump from L2, in use (Marcos Montano 20:07, Brandon Lance confirmed 21:30).
